S3. MATERIAL FINDING (1), sibling of S2's overly narrow shared-reason class: recordRelationshipDeclarations.ts:292 says "The spell record a creature spellcasting trait lists as prepared or innate." It applies that printed classification to two additional at-will occurrences that the source does not list as prepared or innate: creature:archmage /traits/1/mechanics/spellcasting/groups/0/spells/0/ref = spell:disguise-self and /traits/1/mechanics/spellcasting/groups/0/spells/1/ref = spell:invisibility. Independently extracted SRD p.395 says "The archmage can cast disguise self and invisibility at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:"; the prepared list starts with the cantrips and continues on p.396, without these two spells. The importer explicitly captures these pre-list spells as a separate frequency:"at-will" group (creatureSpellcasting.ts:266 onward). Actual lookup_rules({kind:"creature",ref:"creature:archmage"}) returns both resolved spellcasting-spell links with the quoted prepared-or-innate reason. This finding does NOT claim that at-will casting and preparation are mutually exclusive, or that these spells can never be prepared; the false source-semantic claim is that the printed trait lists these occurrences AS prepared or innate, when it lists them separately as at-will. Inferring an unprinted preparation classification via Wizard Spell Mastery (p.53) cannot establish that claim about what the Archmage entry prints. Scenario/consequence: a DM consulting the Archmage's spell options receives an authored relationship explanation that misstates how the source grants those two options, through the same ruleAwareness -> lookup_rules boundary as prior S2. Authority: ADR 0020 section 1 source-faithful rule-awareness and the owning source-grounded declaration requirement. Owner: eshyra-o9bd.16.6 repair/integration lane; no other bead modified. Closure: broaden this shared spellcasting-spell reason to faithfully include at-will as well as prepared and innate spells, retaining both valid links; regenerate the manifest and verify the real lookup output across these categories. This is the same narrow prose-semantic repair class, requiring no resolver/parser redesign. Permanent evidence classification: exact source-backed reproducer for the p.395 pre-list pair, proportionate because generalized family resolution is already protected; do not infer semantic truth from the green pointer-resolution tests. This direct sibling evidence supersedes the prior review's statement that the other four reasons had no mismatch.
